fullSerialCoverage.scope: Configured contracts and desktop services; not renderer or distribution coverage

fullDefaultCoverageRetry.scope: Unchanged default two-worker configuration; a passing retry does not prove the earlier timeout cause is eliminated.

largeWorkspaceNativeReplay.scope: Actual model-comparison continuation, failures, backup/restore, restart and minimum-window checks on a copied retained workspace; not full desktop or packaged proof

mcpFailureReplay.scope: Independent copy of the retained complete-run workspace. Process timings and stdout/stderr byte counts only; no process output or credentials recorded. Did not reproduce the original failure and does not prove its cause was fixed.

fullDesktopAttempt.failure: MCP resource-subscription connection returned a sanitized error in 5005ms; resourceSubscriptionsSupported was false. The underlying connection cause has not been established.

measuredIo.scope: Three isolated Node vault transactions on copies of the same retained workspace; performance depends on data and storage

interruptedCoverage.observation: The process handle was missing after interruption and no matching process or terminal test result remained; it was not counted as passed.

defaultCoverageFailures.observation: Three original 5-second test deadlines expired; a plugin test also reported cleanup ENOTEMPTY after timeout.

isolatedTimeoutReplay.scope: All test assertions passed. The command's global coverage thresholds failed because only three files were selected; this is not full coverage evidence.

initialNativeReplay.correction: The retained seed already had a same-title comparison thread. Use the newly created thread's unique ID in its test title rather than matching either old or new thread ambiguously.

initialRelatedTestFailure.correction: A held compressed backup was compared against decoded bytes. Compare raw bytes on both sides for failed-write preservation, retaining complete decoded comparisons for successful revisions.

pdfVisualReview.scope: Five actual captures from the failed complete source run, individually inspected for title/footer, controls and reading content. Light 1280x840 and dark 760x540. Not complete design, distribution or physical accessibility acceptance.

remaining: Successful full desktop regression on the final build, distribution and release; broader product and UI requirements remain open. Latest main GitHub verification did not start because of account payment/spending limits.
